evaluation.efficiency_estimator: median paired percent change for overlapping-worker trial indices

limitations: This is a post-failure remediation diagnostic, not a confirmatory experiment.
The v1.6.0 baseline and v1.7.1 candidate ran at different times and backend patch levels on the single production app.
The destination and injected overlap are synthetic.
One model and one reasoning setting do not establish universal behavior.
publication_policy: Publish complete, neutral, negative, invalid, and infrastructure results. Keep this output separate from the prior 200-run publication and the incomplete v1.7.0 condition.
